dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal region exhibit irregular, thin, high-intensity perimeters. There is a sharp gradient transition from the dark background pelt to the light-colored perimeter, with the interior of the structures being slightly darker than the perimeter line but lighter than the base pelt.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily at the intersection points of the macro-annuli. These clusters lack internal gradients and are concentrated in the mid-section of the dorsal-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest closed macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an elongated, irregular trapezoid, with the longest edge oriented towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a complex reticulated pattern where individual annuli frequently merge, creating a honeycomb-like interconnected mesh across the central third of the body.
